verses.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.pt: Temamos, pois, para que, havendo sido deixada a promessa de entrar no seu repouso, não pareça que algum de vós tenha ficado para trás.
verses.en_web: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
verses.en_bbe: Let us then, though we still have God's word that we may come into his rest, go in fear that some of you may be unable to do so.

verses.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.pt: Pois também a nós foi pregado o evangelho, assim como a eles; mas a palavra da pregação nada lhes aproveitou, porque não estava combinada com a fé naqueles que a ouviram.
verses.en_web: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
verses.en_bbe: And, truly, the good news came to us, even as it did to them; but the hearing of the word did them no good, because they were not united in faith with the true hearers.

verses.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.pt: Porque nós, os que cremos, entramos no repouso, como ele disse: Então jurei na minha ira: “Eles não entrarão no meu repouso”; ainda que as suas obras já estivessem terminadas desde a fundação do mundo.
verses.en_web: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest”; although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.en_bbe: For those of us who have belief come into his rest; even as he has said, As I said in my oath when I was angry, They may not come into my rest: though the works were done from the time of the making of the world.

verses.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.pt: Pois, em certo lugar, ele disse assim a respeito do dia sétimo: E Deus repousou no sétimo dia de todas as suas obras. Gênesis 2:2
verses.en_web: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works”;
verses.en_bbe: For in one place he has said of the seventh day, And God had rest from all his works on the seventh day;

verses.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.pt: E, outra vez neste texto: Não entrarão no meu repouso.
verses.en_web: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
verses.en_bbe: And in the same place he says again, They will not come into my rest.

verses.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.pt: Portanto, uma vez que resta alguns entrarem no repouso, e que aqueles a quem primeiramente foi pregado o evangelho não entraram por causa da desobediência,
verses.en_web: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
verses.en_bbe: So that as it is clear that some have to go in, and that the first hearers of the good news were not able to go in because they went against God's orders,

verses.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.pt: outra vez ele determina um certo dia, o “hoje”, dizendo por meio de Davi muito tempo depois (como já foi dito): Hoje, se ouvirdes a sua voz, não endureçais os vossos corações.
verses.en_web: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
verses.en_bbe: After a long time, again naming a certain day, he says in David, Today (as he had said before), Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart,

verses.en: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.pt: Pois se Josué tivesse lhes dado repouso, ele não teria falado depois a respeito de outro dia.
verses.en_web: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
verses.en_bbe: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have said anything about another day.

verses.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
verses.pt: Portanto, ainda resta um repouso como o do sábado para o povo de Deus.
verses.en_web: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
verses.en_bbe: So that there is still a Sabbath-keeping for the people of God.

verses.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
verses.pt: Pois aquele que entrou no seu repouso também repousou das suas obras, assim como Deus das suas.
verses.en_web: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
verses.en_bbe: For the man who comes into his rest has had rest from his works, as God did from his.

verses.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.pt: Procuremos, pois, entrar naquele repouso; para que ninguém caia no mesmo exemplo de desobediência.
verses.en_web: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this, let us have a strong desire to come into that rest, and let no one go after the example of those who went against God's orders.

verses.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.pt: Porque a palavra de Deus é viva e eficaz, e mais afiada do que toda espada de dois gumes, e que penetra até a divisão da alma e do espírito, das juntas e das medulas, e é apta para julgar os pensamentos e intenções do coração.
verses.en_web: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
verses.en_bbe: For the word of God is living and full of power, and is sharper than any two-edged sword, cutting through and making a division even of the soul and the spirit, the bones and the muscles, and quick to see the thoughts and purposes of the heart.

verses.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.pt: E não há criatura alguma encoberta diante dele; pelo contrário, todas as coisas estão nuas e expostas aos olhos daquele a quem temos de prestar contas.
verses.en_web: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
verses.en_bbe: And there is nothing made which is not completely clear to him; there is nothing covered, but all things are open to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

verses.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.pt: Visto que temos um grande Sumo Sacerdote, Jesus, o Filho de Deus, que penetrou nos céus, mantenhamos firme a nossa declaração de fé.
verses.en_web: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.
verses.en_bbe: Having then a great high priest, who has made his way through the heavens, even Jesus the Son of God, let us be strong in our faith.

verses.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.pt: Pois não temos um Sumo Sacerdote que não possa se compadecer das nossas fraquezas; mas, sim, um que foi provado em tudo, conforme a nossa semelhança, porém sem pecado.
verses.en_web: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
verses.en_bbe: For we have not a high priest who is not able to be touched by the feelings of our feeble flesh; but we have one who has been tested in all points as we ourselves are tested, but without sin.

verses.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.pt: Portanto, acheguemo-nos com confiança ao trono da graça, para que possamos receber misericórdia e encontrar graça para sermos socorridos no tempo adequado.
verses.en_web: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
verses.en_bbe: Then let us come near to the seat of grace without fear, so that mercy may be given to us, and we may get grace for our help in time of need.
